summary.text: Lee Hewitt is a Republican member of the South Carolina House of Representatives from District 108, in office since November 14, 2016, and he is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Hewitt is assigned to the House Rules Committee and the Ways and Means Committee for 2025-2026.
In 2023-2024 he served on the Ways and Means Committee.
